name: Hartwell Ironweave Insulated Cargo Pant
description: Cold-weather cargo trousers with a quilted thermal lining throughout the legs and seat. The outer shell is a dark, tightly woven synthetic with mild wind resistance. Built for outdoor construction and cold-deck warehouse environments. Bulky through the thigh but surprisingly mobile. Most pairs are navy blue or black.
functionality: Quilted thermal insulation, wind-resistant shell, multiple cargo pockets
what_it_says: You work outside or in unheated spaces, and you've learned to layer properly.
story_hooks: The quilted lining can be partially removed through a seam — some workers carry flat items between the shell and liner rather than in visible pockets.
Hartwell Ironweave is recognizable enough that wearing it signals you're from a cold-work environment, which tells people something about where you spend your days.
